children: BlockBeats reported on September 4 that, according to TradingBeats monitoring, four key addresses had placed about $118 million in buy orders below $76,700 when BTC was trading at $78,765. According to BlockBeats On-chain Detection, the earlier bullish view was later confirmed by price action and address behavior, although the original $118 million in orders was not fully filled.

Smart money address 0x1367 emerged as the strongest performer in the signal set. It had placed buy orders between $76,000 and $76,700, then successfully accumulated near $76,233 and later took profits while rolling positions. It still holds 271 BTC long positions worth about $21.915 million, with unrealized gains of about $952,000. Including realized gains, its total profit in this round is about $1.6 million. The address has now placed new orders to partially take profit on BTC longs between $82,281 and $83,200 and on ETH longs between $2,527 and $2,625, with each profit-taking position accounting for about 35%.

Address 0x469e had planned to add positions between $69,000 and $73,700, but deeper buy orders were never triggered. It first closed about $18.8 million in BTC longs near $78,606 today for a profit of about $47,000, then raised its entry range to $81,193 to $81,200 and bought back 200 BTC.

Address 0x7665 had planned to buy back between $72,500 and $75,369, but instead repurchased at least 150 BTC earlier than planned between $77,723 and $78,748 at an average price of about $78,312, booking a profit of about $204,000. Its BTC position and orders have now been cleared.
Address 0x92b7 is still waiting largely as planned, with its buy orders for about $32.495 million between $74,669 and $74,752 remaining unfilled.

BTC rose sharply without revisiting the main buy zone, prompting whales to move positions higher in advance. At present, 0x1367 and 0x469e together still hold 471 BTC long positions worth about $38.088 million.

title: Bitcoin Whale Addresses Shift Higher as BTC Rallies Past Key Buy Zones
